# S4.11 — MCP server: lab read/launch/experiment/results groups (C1 `hh-lab/1`)

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.10` (PR #73) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands the C1 `hh-lab/1` MCP server slice — ticket 073,
`R-2.11.3¹` (AC-R-2.11.3-{3–5,7–9,12–13}). A new leaf crate,
`crates/hh-mcp-lab`, fronts the kernel for MCP-only callers over both
declared transports with one dispatch chain; every `tools/call` is a
durable surface-session turn (`turn.*` + `action.effect.*` +
`budget.consumed`), authority comes from the transport never the
message, and the surface's only ledger path is the audited
`EmbedService::surface_*` seam.

## What changed

- **`crates/hh-mcp-lab/`** (new) — the surface server:
  - `server.rs`/`http.rs` — nd-JSON-RPC stdio; Streamable HTTP
    `POST /mcp` (one frame/request; `Mcp-Session-Id` on initialize;
    400/401/403/404/405 legs; `202` on notifications; SSE half
    deferred — DF-S4.11-1).
  - `binding.rs` — `CallerBinding`/`CallerKind`/`CallerCredential`/
    `BindingTable`; stdio-launch + bearer `CallerAuth` (H3 mediator →
    DF-S4.11-2).
  - `session.rs`/`effects.rs` — `run_kind = surface` session per
    binding (lazy, restart-rebindable via manifest scan + lease
    re-acquire); the full intended→authorized→prepared→committed/
    observed/refused chain per call; `control.budget.consumed` per
    turn, idempotent.
  - `launch.rs` — `launch_run` with the budget gate
    (`MissingBudget`/`InsufficientBudget` refuse *before*
    `open_session`), committed write-ahead, `spawn_event` causality,
    `hnd-run-*` mints; `cancel_run`, `submit_input`,
    `respond_approval` (human-only endorsement).
  - `reads.rs`/`dispatch.rs` — read + experiment + results groups:
    `read_ledger`, `run_status`, `get_trace`,
    `list_pending_approvals`, `open_experiment`, `run_exit`, `pause`,
    `send_input`, `get_experiment_report`, `get_matrix`, `export_run`
    — all through `ExposurePolicy`, all serving with
    `measurement.export.delivered` on the read run.
  - `supply.rs` — caller-supplied surfaces Π-evaluated against their
    own artifact (`callable ⇔ revealed`; `deny`/`ask`/`allow`;
    durable `security.permission.pending` on ask — reply →
    DF-S4.11-3).
  - `handles.rs` — `hnd-<kind>-<idp>` mints on `lifecycle.surface.call.minted`;
    owner-scoped resolution, `UnknownHandle`/`NoCoveringGrant`/
    `HandleExpired`.
  - `exposure.rs` — the `hh-lab/1` exposure document as data:
    `parse → link → lower` → `ServedArtifact`; assumption-debt
    carriers (`tasks_carrier`, `legacy_era_projection`,
    `caller_binding.<kind>`) required at link.
- **`crates/hh-embed-schema/`** — `OpenSpec::New.spawn_event:
  SpawnEventRef{run_id,event_id}` (additive schema member).
- **`crates/hh-embed/`** — the `surface_*` seam (open-run, writer
  lease, append/commit, events, manifest, ids, account, fault
  injection, `alloc_id`/`now_ms`/`ts_now`) + `spawn_event` plumbing
  into `manifest.spawn_event`.
- **`crates/hh-ledger/`** — `classes.rs` re-export the seam's
  payload-builder uses.
- **Generated (CC7, schema is source):**
  `schema/hh-embed-1.schema.json`,
  `hh-embed-client-generated/src/generated.rs` (nullable
  `spawn_event` member), `Cargo.toml`/`Cargo.lock` (workspace member).
- **Docs:** ADR-0303, `docs/build/runs/S4.11.md`, DF-S4.11-{1..3}
  rows in `DEFERRALS.md`, BUILD_INDEX row, LEDGER advance to S4.12.

## Testing

`cargo test -p hh-mcp-lab` — **11/11**:

- `ac3_respond_approval_caller_kind_gate` — non-human →
  `IllegitimateEndorsement` (durable refused row).
- `ac4_missing_and_insufficient_budget` — typed refusals
  before `open_session`; undeclared dims refuse (no silent skip).
- `ac4_ac8_launch_spawn_event_and_resume` — launch → `hnd-run` +
  committed; `manifest.spawn_event` names the surface run's committed
  effect; restart rebinds the same run, no double-charge; cancel
  `requested→accepted`.
- `ac5_per_turn_instrument_charges` — `tool_calls:+1` per turn,
  `charged_to: instrument`, idempotent.
- `ac7_read_ledger_policy_fold_and_delivered` — `ExposurePolicy`
  fold + `measurement.export.delivered` on the read run.
- `handle_is_a_name_not_a_capability` — mints/owner-scope/expiry,
  typed handle refusals.
- `ac9_supply_surface_pi` — deny/ask/allow + `pending` row +
  `PermissionAskRequired`; `callable ⇔ revealed`.
- `ac12_assumption_debt_required_at_link` — link fails closed.
- `ac13_every_tool_wraps_a_real_op_or_declared_lowering` — every tool
  wraps a real op or a declared lowering; `tools/list` byte-identical
  across transports.
- `ac11_stdio_loop` / `ac11_http_transport` — both wire shapes.

## Verification

- `cargo test --workspace` — green at closeout.
- `cargo clippy -p hh-mcp-lab --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings`
  — clean. Full-workspace clippy carries pre-existing untouched-crate
  failures (`hh-fleet`, `hh-control`, `fleet_ops.rs`, `never_loop`
  drift under Rust 1.94.1) — same ruling as S4.10: scoped clean,
  unrelated debt recorded.
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check` — clean on touched files; remaining
  diffs are pre-existing rustfmt drift in untouched S4.9 code
  (`hh-fleet/*`, `fleet_ops.rs`, `hh-ledger` S4.9 files) — recorded.
- `scripts/check-drift.sh` — green (schema + generated client
  regenerated for `spawn_event`).
- `scripts/check-removability.sh` — green incl. the new S4.11 stanza:
  `hh-mcp-lab` is edge-free upward (removing the crate removes the
  feature; no kernel crate consumes it).
- `check-build-memory.sh` — green at closeout.

## Deferrals / gates

- **Opened:** DF-S4.11-1 (SSE half of Streamable HTTP), DF-S4.11-2
  (H3 oauth/mtls `CallerAuth`), DF-S4.11-3 (surface-run Π-ask reply
  path).
- **Unchanged:** DF-S4.10-1 HUMAN-H1 (E3 surface binding) remains
  **gate pending** — an operator gate, not a code state; the
  generated-client proxy carries the real transport meanwhile.
